title: The Great Beyond
overview: An author of popular fantasy novels discovers that the mythical world he’s known for creating is actually real.

title: The Haunting of Hotel Transylvania
overview: Drac has happily settled into retirement while Mavis takes the reins of the legendary monster hotel. But when a series of spooky and unexplained happenings sends chills through the resort, the Drac Pack embarks on its most spellbinding adventure yet: uncovering the mystery behind the haunting of Hotel Transylvania.

title: Sleepover
overview: Billed as the "quintessential sleepover nightmare". Plot TBA.

title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Search for Maria Flores
overview: Fanfilm prequel of the first Texas Chain Saw Massacre, based on the lore of the game by Gun Media.  In April 1973, a college student named Maria Flores goes missing in rural Texas during a photography trip to capture the blooming spring wildflowers.  Maria's younger sister, Ana Flores, refuses to give up on her.  She gathers a group of college friends to head out to the last known area Maria visited.

title: The Mummy: Book of the Dead
overview: The fourth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Saki Sanobashi: Go For A Punch
overview: After being kidnapped, six people suddenly find themselves awake in what appears to be a bathroom? Just like the food and water, the little hope of escape they once had is slowly being eaten away by the realization that no one is coming to save them and that they will all decay here.

title: Unlike You
overview: A flailing screenwriter finally hits gold when he starts to implement his dreams into his stories, landing him a contract with a huge studio backing and a massive budget. But when he realizes the woman he's been seeing in his dreams is real, he begins to wonder what has been real and what been his own minds production.

title: Brad Henderson’s Halloween
overview: A  bold reinvention of the Halloween series from the visionary mind of Brad Henderson
